annotations.title: Explain how to fix an accessibility rule

description: Use this when the user asks what an axe-core accessibility rule means or how to fix it — such as color-contrast, image-alt, label or link-name. Returns plain-English steps and a code example. Do not use it when the user wants a site checked; it explains a rule and does not scan pages.
